dedupe_keys.name: sdwa inequalities dataset safe drinking water access indicators and inequality indexes for brazilian municipalities

description: This dataset gives, for every Brazilian municipality, an indicator of safe drinking water access and indexes of how unequally that access is distributed by income. Access is weighted by source, with the general distribution network, on-property wells or springs, cisterns and other sources such as tank trucks or rivers given different weights by the AHP method, and inequality is measured with adapted Gini, concentration and dissimilarity indexes from Lorenz curves built on census tracts. Researchers at INPE, Brazil's National Institute for Space Research, derived it from the 2010 Demographic Census and published it on Zenodo in February 2023 as one Excel file, a free download under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is national. Caveats: it reflects 2010 census conditions, and the source weights are expert judgements. Simulation uses: targeting network expansion and drought resilience measures at municipalities with unequal access in capacity planning and adaptation studies. Related record: the Ontario First Nations and municipal water services archive (data-ontario-first-nations-municipal-water-services-2009-2010).
